summary: Per-task timeouts: use a module's timeout option, or the ansible_command_timeout variable when it has none, for slow operations like copying running-config to startup-config on IOS.
questions: How do I stop copy running-config startup-config from timing out?
How do I set a command timeout for one network task?

answer_card.title: Per-task command timeout
answer_card.answer_md:
```yaml
- name: save running-config
  cisco.ios.ios_command:
    commands: copy running-config startup-config
  vars:
    ansible_command_timeout: 60
```
Use the module's own `timeout` option if it has one. Saving config on IOS often needs more than the default 30 seconds.
